children: Transom Capital Public Fund, LP disclosed a 1.16% stake in SoundThinking, Inc. in a Schedule 13D filing. The filing, accepted on September 30, 2026, details a deal signed on September 28 to launch a tender offer through affiliated entities. The move aims to take SoundThinking private for $8.00 per share plus a CVR of up to $3.00 per share.

Affiliates of Transom Capital Public Fund agreed to commence a tender offer within 15 business days to buy all SoundThinking shares for $8.00 per share plus one contingent value right worth up to $3.00 upon set milestones. “Parent will commence a tender offer to buy all shares for $8.00 plus a CVR worth up to $3.00.”

If enough shares are tendered to exceed 50% ownership, the parties will complete a follow-on merger under Delaware Section 251(h) to take SoundThinking private, after which the stock will be delisted. The offer will be funded with committed equity from an affiliate and debt, and it is backed by support deals from Veradace (about 15.8%) and the Lauder Stockholders (about 17%), with the Lauder group agreeing to reinvest alongside Transom affiliates. “After the offer, the parties will complete a 251(h) merger to take SoundThinking private.”

Transom Capital Public Fund, LP is an investment vehicle focused on equity and equity-like securities, with emphasis on software and technology-enabled solutions. It is affiliated with Transom Capital Group, a Los Angeles-based private equity firm known for hands-on operational improvement, corporate carve-outs, and complex transitions. The fund’s leadership includes Russell Roenick, a co-founder and managing partner of Transom Capital Group.
